purpose.note: The hero identifies a personal SWE learning OS for interview preparation, the audience, the evidence-gated learning loop, a real first-session plan, guest and signed-in access, maintenance-only state, and the absence of checkout.

design.note: The restrained black, white, and cyan evidence-led workbench feels specific to engineering practice. It uses a real plan and artifact contract as proof instead of generic feature cards. Exact 390, 768, and 1440 captures show clean reflow and no horizontal overflow.

seo.note: The homepage response passes every substantive on-page and site-level check. The sole warning is the expected local-origin versus production-origin sitemap comparison. A 315-page local link crawl found zero internal errors and zero internal redirects; app drill and utility routes are intentionally outside the public curriculum sitemap.

geo.note: Production already passes the complete Fleet agent-index contract, including Markdown coverage and the bounded catalog surfaces.

performance.note: All twenty production-faithful Pages-runtime audits completed. The new matching first-paint shell moved the acceptance gate from needs-work to good and cut mid-mobile LCP by roughly one second. The deliberately brutal slow-3G low-end profile remains the only weak edge; CLS and weighted TBT are zero.

verification.primaryJourney: A visitor can understand the learning mechanism, inspect a real first-session plan, browse public curriculum proof, and start as a guest or sign in for durable progress without encountering invented pricing.
verification.repositoryCheck: The complete quality gate passes format, lint, TypeScript, 551 tests, source health, complexity, duplication, cycles, dependency checks, docs, production build, size budgets, and repository hygiene.
verification.seoAudit: 17 passed, 0 failed, 1 local-origin warning; 315 sitemap pages crawl with zero internal errors or redirects.

footer.note: The explicit project strip remains mounted and Ask AI loads after window load with compose disabled, preventing it from replacing the strip.

limitations: No deployment, commit, push, migration, DNS change, account action, or production configuration change was performed.
The temporary Cloudflare quick tunnel has no uptime guarantee and exists only to review the current local Pages candidate.
The synthetic slow-3G plus 6x CPU profile remains below the desired performance band, while the weighted coverage profile and all other device classes are good.
INP requires field interaction data and is not measured by Lighthouse navigation mode.
